nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the .NET 9 ASP.NET Core API: compiles and publishes the ExcelManagement.Api project in an SDK image, then copies the published output into a slim ASP.NET runtime image and runs it via dotnet ExcelManagement.Api.dll.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-stage build (sdk build stage, aspnet runtime stage) keeps the final image free of SDK/build tooling.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Build stage based on the .NET 9 SDK image that restores and publishes the ExcelManagement.Api project from source.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: Runtime stage based on the .NET 9 ASP.NET image that copies the published build output and sets the container entrypoint to run the API.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes build output directories (bin/, obj/) from the Docker build context for the API, keeping the image build fast and avoiding stale binaries from the host.
